title: ACQUIRED: A Dataset for Answering Counterfactual Questions In Real-Life Videos

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating unimodal language-only models (e.g., DeBERTa, UnifiedQA, GPT) on a multimodal video question answering dataset without providing visual inputs, in order to measure how much the models exploit text-only statistical artifacts and human annotation patterns rather than performing genuine multimodal reasoning.
